text.p: Italian middleweight boxer Fabrizio De Chiara was in a coma on Sunday after collapsing during an Italian title fight.

De Chiara, previously unbeaten in a 12-fight career, collapsed after being stopped near the end of his 12-round contest against Vincenzo Imparato in the Italian west coast port of Massa late on Saturday, and left the ring on a stretcher.
The rest of the programme was abandoned.
He was taken to hospital in Pisa where doctors said he had major internal bleeding and operated immediately.
Doctors said the operation lasted around four hours and De Chiara's condition remained very serious.
An updated medical bulletin was expected later.
